title: The Last Letter
text: A dead courier lies in the ditch with arrows in his back. In his satchel is a sealed letter, addressed to your House in a careful hand. He was carrying it for a Lost Scion, and he very nearly made it.

options.label: Break the seal and read it; the Lost cannot wait on courtesy.

outcomes.text: It tells where they are and how long they can hold. Their fear shows in every line.

options.label: Carry it home unopened, as the courier meant to.

outcomes.text: Your honor is kept, though the weight of not knowing comes with it.

options.label: The healer prepares the courier's body for burial, as he deserves.

outcomes.text: In his pocket they find a second letter, which tells of a faster way to reach the Lost.
